b: Alpha-globin genes are located on chromosome 16. Most people have four functional alpha-globin genes: two inherited from each parent.
Clinical severity generally depends on the number of affected genes.
One gene affected – silent carrier: the person is generally clinically well.

Two genes affected – alpha thalassaemia trait: the person may have microcytosis with little or no anaemia. The two affected genes may be on the same chromosome (cis deletion, --/αα) or on opposite chromosomes (trans deletion, -α/-α). This d
